name: Veronica Hale
source:
Became captain of the Celestara at an unprecedented age, defying every expectation placed on her. She shares a deep, complicated history with [url=/c166738]Liv[/url], [url=/c166731]Talia[/url], and [url=/c166739]Amina[/url], bonds forged through past missions that not all of them remember fondly. Daughter of the legendary [url=/c166740]Admiral Hale[/url], commander of the battleship Prometheus. She hasn't returned to Earth in years, and her public presence is minimal, carefully controlled, almost deliberately mysterious.
